name: swapmart
description: SWAPMART — A Secure Peer-to-Peer Recommerce Marketplace for Consumer Electronics in Tanzania

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run -w @swapmart/api build && npm run -w @swapmart/web build
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run -w @swapmart/api dev" "npm run -w @swapmart/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run -w @swapmart/api typecheck && npm run -w @swapmart/web typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run -w @swapmart/api test:unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run -w @swapmart/api test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run -w @swapmart/api test:e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run build
